Documentation: Hospital buyer authenticates via Entra External ID (B2B)
Reseller authenticates via Entra External ID (B2B)
Entra returns JWT with customer_id claim identifying the authenticated customer
Portal calls Backend API with auth token: GET /my-packs, GET /my-orders
Backend queries Analytics DB: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_account = {authenticated_customer}
MedPack API returns pack BOM, components, pricing for customer's packs
Analytics DB returns order history, inventory, forecasts for customer
Backend returns combined, filtered data to Portal for display
MedPack Aus provides pack data to API
MedPack NZ provides pack data to API
QAD EE feeds orders, inventory, financials to Analytics DB
